description: This file defines an interface IBatchContainerBatch in the Orleans.Streams namespace, representing a batch of queue messages that consolidates multiple IBatchContainer instances.

classes.name: IBatchContainerBatch
classes.description: An interface for a batch of queue messages, extending IBatchContainer, that includes a list of contained batch instances.

methods.name: BatchContainers
methods.description: A property getter that retrieves the list of batch containers comprising this batch.
